title: Nonlocal Boundary Value Problems Governed by Symmetric Nonlocal Operators
summary: Nonlocal boundary value problems with Dirichlet or Neumann boundary are well-studied for nonlocal operators of the type $\mathcal{L}_γu = \operatorname{PV} \int_{\mathbb{R}^d} \big(u(\cdot)-u(y)\big) γ(\cdot,y) \, \mathrm{d}y$ where the underlying kernel function $γ: \mathbb{R}^d \times \mathbb{R}^d \rightarrow [0,\infty)$ is assumed to be measurable and symmetric.
